Island oni are those powerful enough to claim small coastal islands, often creating makeshift armies of lesser oni who pillage surrounding lands and waters. Island oni hoard this material wealth, garbing themselves in luxurious clothing and adorning their monstrous faces with all manner of jewelry. Island oni typically scavenge sunken shipwrecks for weapons, armor, and treasure. This can also bring them into contact with undead sailors, which island oni have been known to press into service. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 36 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 34 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 31 [Island Oni](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3124) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 254 **Perception** +32; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), mist vision **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +30, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +33, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +32, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +32, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +29 **Str** +9 **Dex** +6 **Con** +6 **Int** +2 **Wis** +9 **Cha** +6 **Mist Vision** The island oni ignores the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) condition from fog and mist. **Items** _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=361)_ --- **AC** 38 **Fort** +26 **Ref** +28 **Will** +34 +1 status on all saves vs. [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732) **HP** 390 **Immunities** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) **Weaknesses** bean panic, spirit 20 **Bean Panic** Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76). While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.
**Lost Oni Island** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676)) An island oni can claim an island of up to 1-mile radius in a process that takes 1 week, during which the oni must defeat any who come to challenge its claim. If successful, the oni can freely control the weather on its island and in a 1-mile radius from the shore, with the effect of a successful [_control weather_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=116) ritual. This altered weather surrounds the island in thick fog, seaborne mirages, or other phenomena that increase the DC of checks to locate and navigate to the island (Such as [Sailing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) or [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49)) to 40, though the oni can allow allies to pass freely. If the oni dies or leaves the island, the weather returns to normal immediately.
**[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 40 feet, fly 40 feet, swim 50 feet; [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1756) **Melee** _longspear_ +35 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+10 piercing plus 2d6 electricity **Melee** jaws +33 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d6+10 piercing plus 2d6 [persistent electricity](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Ranged** thunderbolt +30 ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d12+12 electricity plus [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) for 1 round **Primal Innate Spells** DC 37 2nd invisibility (at will^ self only) - **Constant (9th)** [Water Walk](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=55)** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The island oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=628) creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning). **Conductive Downpour** ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134), [Water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) The island oni fires a bolt of lightning into the air, which immediately roils with dark clouds. Rain falls in a 60-foot radius emanation, centered on the oni, for 1 minute, filling the air and pooling on the ground. Creatures in the aura gain weakness 10 to electricity, and the entire area is greater [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) for [Flying](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312)creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground or [Climbing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374), unless they also have a swim Speed. **Electrifying Pierce** ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) **Requirements** The island oni's last action was a successful longspear Strike against a Medium or smaller target; **Effect** The island oni drives the spear through the target and calls lightning to strike the spear. The target takes 6d6 electricity damage with a DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is also impaled on the spear. It's [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77), and if the oni moves, they bring the grabbed creature along with them. The island oni doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the creature grabbed; the creature remains grabbed as long as it's impaled. The grabbed creature can attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) as normal. The island oni can only have one creature impaled this way at a time. **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** medium, 3d8+10 bludgeoning, Rupture 30 **Tripping Tide** ([Water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) The island oni sweeps their spear in a full circle, releasing waves of seawater. All creatures in a 20-foot emanation must succeed a DC 37 Reflex Saving throw or fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).
